title: stachys rigida var. quercetorum
intro: Stachys rigida var. quercetorum, commonly known as the Oak-leaf Betony, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). The Oak-leaf Betony is valued for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and anxiety, as well as providing relief from digestive issues and cold symptoms. The therapeutic actions of the Oak-leaf Betony include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful for treating muscle cramps, respiratory issues, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of the Oak-leaf Betony include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
